translations.asad: CONSIDER the daybreak
translations.sahih: By the dawn

translations.asad: and the ten nights!
translations.sahih: And [by] ten nights

translations.asad: Consider the multiple and the One!
translations.sahih: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

translations.asad: Consider the night as it runs its course!
translations.sahih: And [by] the night when it passes,

text.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

translations.asad: Considering all this - could there be, to anyone endowed with reason, a [more] solemn evidence of the truth?
translations.sahih: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

text.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

translations.asad: ART THOU NOT aware of how thy Sustainer has dealt with [the tribe of] ‘Ad,
translations.sahih: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -

translations.asad: [the people of] Iram the many-pillared,
translations.sahih: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

text.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

translations.asad: the like of whom has never been reared in all the land? –
translations.sahih: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

translations.asad: and with [the tribe of] Thamud, who hollowed out rocks in the valley? –
translations.sahih: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

translations.asad: and with Pharaoh of the [many] tent-poles?
translations.sahih: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -

translations.asad: [It was they] who transgressed all bounds of equity all over their lands,
translations.sahih: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

translations.asad: and brought about great corruption therein:
translations.sahih: And increased therein the corruption.

translations.asad: and therefore thy Sustainer let loose upon them a scourge of suffering:
translations.sahih: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

translations.asad: for, verily, thy Sustainer is ever on the watch!
translations.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

text.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

translations.asad: BUT AS FOR man, whenever his Sustainer tries him by His generosity and by letting him enjoy a life of ease, he says, "My Sustainer has been [justly] generous towards me";
translations.sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

text.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

translations.asad: whereas, whenever He tries him by straitening his means of livelihood, he says, "My Sustainer has disgraced me!"
translations.sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

translations.asad: But nay, nay, [O men, consider all that you do and fail to do:] you are not generous towards the orphan,
translations.sahih: No! But you do not honor the orphan

translations.asad: and you do not urge one another to feed the needy,
translations.sahih: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

translations.asad: and you devour the inheritance [of others] with devouring greed,
translations.sahih: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

translations.asad: and you love wealth with boundless love!
translations.sahih: And you love wealth with immense love.

text.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا

translations.asad: Nay, but [how will you fare on Judgment Day,] when the earth is crushed with crushing upon crushing,
translations.sahih: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -

translations.asad: and [the majesty of] thy Sustainer stands revealed, as well as [the true nature of] the angels; rank upon rank?
translations.sahih: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

text.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

translations.asad: And on that Day hell will be brought [within sight]; on that Day man will remember [all that he did and failed to do]: but what will that remembrance avail him?
translations.sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?

translations.asad: He will say, "Oh, would that I had. provided beforehand for my life [to come]!"
translations.sahih: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

translations.asad: For, none can make suffer as He will make suffer [the sinners] on that Day,
translations.sahih: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

translations.asad: and none can bind with bonds like His.
translations.sahih: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

translations.asad: [But unto the righteous God will say,] "O thou human being that hast attained to inner peace!
translations.sahih: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

translations.asad: Return thou unto thy Sustainer, well-pleased [and] pleasing [Him]:
translations.sahih: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

translations.asad: enter, then, together with My [other true] servants –
translations.sahih: And enter among My [righteous] servants

translations.asad: yea, enter thou My paradise!"
translations.sahih: And enter My Paradise."
